---
name: vibeschool-observability-reliability
description: Ensure VibeSchool failures, health, freshness, retries and recovery are visible and actionable without creating false operational truth.
---
# Observability and Reliability
Instrument meaningful state transitions and failures with bounded privacy-safe metadata, timestamps, environment/version identity and correlation where appropriate. Distinguish client telemetry from authoritative backend state. Verify heartbeat/watchdog independence, stale-data detection, timeout/retry semantics, alerts and recovery evidence. Monitoring must fail visibly; missing telemetry must not be presented as healthy. Avoid high-cardinality/secrets/PII leakage and unnecessary external cost.
